meta.name: makers-cli
meta.description: EdgeOne Makers CLI command reference. Use when running edgeone CLI commands for dev, build, deploy, env management.

copy.tagline: 用命令行管理开发、构建和部署流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常用 EdgeOne CLI 进行开发部署
copy.tagline_en: Manage dev, build, and deploy workflows via CLI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use EdgeOne CLI for development and deployment

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以帮你运行 EdgeOne Makers CLI 命令，包括本地开发、构建、部署、环境变量管理等操作。
howto.when: 当你需要开发、构建或部署 EdgeOne Makers 项目，或者管理远程环境变量时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 EdgeOne Makers 启动本地开发服务器。
say.note: 运行 edgeone makers dev 命令。

say.text: 部署当前项目到 EdgeOne Makers 预览环境。
设置远程环境变量 WSA_API_KEY 为 my-key。
say.note: 运行 edgeone makers env set 命令。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you run EdgeOne Makers CLI commands, including local development, building, deploying, and environment variable management.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to develop, build, or deploy an EdgeOne Makers project, or manage remote environment variables.

say_en.text: Start the local dev server for EdgeOne Makers.
Deploy the current project to EdgeOne Makers preview environment.
Set remote env var WSA_API_KEY to my-key.
